messages:
maria: Heads-up — NimbusPay (dedicated) reporting p99 timeouts since 03:05 UTC, right after the canary roll. CS escalated to P1. Need short-term routing/workaround and an owner for a fix. Who can take this?

sam: On it. Any error patterns or logs we can look at? @ara please paste what CS has.

ara: Customer saw many 504s and model timeouts. Logs show repeated kv_cache misses and lots of replays. Snippet: `2026-03-18T03:06:12Z ERROR kv_cache miss key=sha:...`; spike aligns with canary.

jin: I can take infra side — suspect autoscaler + cache eviction thrash. Adding myself to this thread.

lee: Ill check runtime config and batch parameters. Which model/variant is on pool-nimbus-3? @ara?

ara: They pinned `redwood/clarion-13b-q4` on pool-nimbus-3. Spike begins ~03:00 after canary shift.

sam: Quick proposed plan: 1) revert canary to previous variant 2) temporarily increase cache TTL and reduce batch_max_tokens to ease memory pressure 3) open an emergency PR to limit KV cache shard_count. Who can do each?

jin: I'll trigger rollback to previous variant now. Running: `deploy-bot rollback --pool pool-nimbus-3 --target clarion-13b-q3`

deploy-bot: rollback started at 03:18 UTC, tracking id db-7751.

lee: I'll prep a config PR for cache TTL and batch size change and tag you for review.

sam: @lee please tag me in the PR, I'll do a quick review ASAP. ETA?

lee: PR up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/+/r12345 — change: cache.shard_count=8 -> 4, cache.ttl=60s, batch.max_tokens=256. Marked emergency.

sam: Reviewing now. Quick pass done, left one nit on constant naming. Will approve for emergency merge after jin confirms rollback.

jin: Rollback completed at 03:27 UTC. Early metrics show p99 latency trending down. Switching autoscaler to manual for next 30m to avoid flapping.

ara: Notifying customer now with interim workaround note. Will update when they confirm.

maria: Thanks. After we stabilize, please add a postmortem stub and a follow-up ticket for longer-term fixes (cache admission, canary gating). Tentative ownership: runtime (lee) for the cache fix, infra (jin) for autoscaler/runbooks, sam for rollout gating and CRs. OK?

sam: Agree. I'll open a ticket labeled p1/customer-nimbus/postmortem and link the PRs. Also pinging oncall rotation for a 1h watch.

jin: I'll watch metrics and post a final snapshot at 04:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: smoke tests passed at 03:35 UTC for pool-nimbus-3.

ara: Customer replied: "latency improved, thanks." :thumbsup:

maria: Nice work everyone. We'll keep the interim measures for 30m and close incident once stable. Thanks — huge help. :heart:
